mentions.snippet: 16-9, Coach Art Walker said the game was pretty even. "Both team had some good chances to score and didn't." He said the fullbacks Sandy Steinke, Kelly Miller, Erin Schuler and Heather Rich "did a nice job" in the game. The Lady Redskins host Moriah Wednesday. The junior varsity did not play Monday after a 2-2 tie with Tupper Lake Friday. Saranac Lake 1, AuSable Valley
